ops.title: Remove .github/workflows (ci.yml, deny.yml) and declare what only CI ran as sylva's own checks
ops.body: Rule ci.closed (baseline 2026.10.12 onward, the open todos ask it): sylva is closed to contributions, so it has no workflows. Before deleting ci.yml and deny.yml, declare as tend tests or gates what only CI ran: the no_std build for wasm32 (`--no-default-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`, the target pinned in rust-toolchain.toml), each feature set, and the rest of ci.yml, beside the rust profile's checks (fmt, clippy, test, cargo deny), so they run in git hooks before a commit and a push. Check with a deliberately failing check as the control. Whether sylva opens to contributions (it's public and on crates.io) is the user's call; CI comes back with it.
